Historic perimeter apartments coexist with modern render and brick infill; this is not the whole metropolitan municipality or a legal conservation boundary.

influence_polygon.note: Authored union of five mapped districts: Norrmalm, Vasastaden, Östermalm, Kungsholmen district (eastern island), and Södermalm. Gamla Stan is excluded. This is an architecture influence envelope, not a claim that all buildings share one period. Exact OSM source relations and versions are recorded in osm/boundaries.source.json; no simplification or resampling.

places.coverage: Ordinary housing within the municipality of Athens. Postwar and later reinforced-concrete apartment stock with rendered facades and flat roof terraces dominates; small surviving older pitched-roof houses are a scale-limited minority. Does not extend to all Attica or portray monuments as housing.

places.art_interpretation: Older office core between West India Avenue, North Dock, Bellmouth Passage and South Dock. Only Commercial or Unknown source buildings at least 19m tall and 200m²; observed Residential, Civic, Industrial and small retail remain outside this recipe. Wood Wharf, Canary Riverside, North Quay and Marsh Wall are outside the authored polygon.

influence_polygon.note: Authored office-core outline through exact pinned dock and street vertices; straight links are art bounds, not legal estate boundaries. The separate source-use eligibility is mandatory.
